import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); q = int(data[1])
    idx = 2
    hx = [1]
    hy = [0]
    x, y = 1, 0
    t = 0
    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        typ = data[idx]; idx += 1
        if typ == b'1':
            c = data[idx]; idx += 1
            if c == b'R':
                x += 1
            elif c == b'L':
                x -= 1
            elif c == b'U':
                y += 1
            else:
                y -= 1
            hx.append(x)
            hy.append(y)
            t += 1
        else:
            p = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
            k = t - (p - 1)
            if k >= 0:
                out.append(f"{hx[k]} {hy[k]}")
            else:
                out.append(f"{p - t} 0")

            idx += 2
            k = t + n - p
            out.append(f"{xs[k]} {ys[k]}")

                x -= 1

            pos += 2
            idx = t + n - p
            out.append(f"{xs[idx]} {ys[idx]}")

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    q = int(data[1])
    xs = [0] * (n + q + 1)
    ys = [0] * (n + q + 1)
    # H[i] = (n - i, 0) for i in 0..n-1
    for i in range(n):
        xs[i] = n - i
        ys[i] = 0
    cur = n  # next free index
    cx, cy = 1, 0
    # head is at index n-1 with position (1,0)
    out = []
    pos = 2
    for _ in range(q):
        t = data[pos]
        if t == b'1':
            c = data[pos + 1]
            pos += 2
            if c == b'R':
                cx += 1
            elif c == b'L':
                cx -= 1
            elif c == b'U':
                cy += 1
            else:
                cy -= 1
            xs[cur] = cx
            ys[cur] = cy
            cur += 1
        else:
            p = int(data[pos + 1])
            pos += 2
            idx = cur - p
            out.append(f"{xs[idx]} {ys[idx]}")
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else ""))
